name: app-tilted-laptop-with-pearl-glass-finance-dashboard-on-blue-velvet
title: Pearl frosted banking dashboard on a laptop tilted low over a blue ribbed velvet surface
whatItIs: A dark laptop in perspective against a pale blue-grey wall showing a light frosted dashboard with an available balance, quick actions, revenue and expense tiles, an activity chart, transactions and upcoming payments lists, a send-money panel with a Continue button and a gradient credit card, resting on ribbed blue velvet.
whatItMeans: Calm and premium; soft glass and a tactile velvet make finance feel gentle.
techniques: Tilt the laptop low in perspective.
Use frosted glass tiles on a pale blue base.
Rest the device on a tactile fabric.
Set numerals in a light sans.

vocabulary.definition: A laptop shot from a low angle.
A soft surface with parallel ridges.
A translucent tile with a metric.
A panel with amount and a Continue button.
